sequence-lights.title: Light Sequence
sequence-lights.description: Remember the order in which the cells light up.

practice.yourTurn: Now tap them in the same order
practice.grows: Get it right and the sequence grows longer
practice.recap: There are 8 rounds. Get one right and the sequence grows; miss and it shrinks.

arrows.title: Arrows
arrows.description: Focus only on the middle arrow, even when the others try to distract you.

practice.center: Tap the way the middle arrow points
practice.trick: Careful: the side arrows try to trick you. Only the middle one counts
practice.recap: You have 60 seconds. Each mistake costs 20 points: be quick, but don't guess. On a keyboard: ← and →.

same-different.title: Same or Different?
same-different.description: Decide as fast as you can whether each symbol matches the previous one.
same-different.question: Does it match the previous one?

practice.question: Is it the same as the one before?
practice.compare: Always compare with the one just before
practice.hint1: Before there was a star: it's the same
practice.hint2: Before there was a star, now a heart: it's different
practice.hint3: Before there was a heart: it's the same
practice.recap: You have 60 seconds. Streaks multiply your points; each mistake costs 10 and resets the streak.

rule-switch.title: Rule Switch
rule-switch.description: Match cards by color or by shape, and adapt when the rule changes.

practice.round1: The rule says COLOR: find the card with the same color
practice.round3: The rule changed! Now find the same SHAPE
practice.round4: Always check the sign on top
practice.hintColor: The rule is COLOR and the middle card is {{color}}
practice.hintShape: The rule is SHAPE and the middle card is a {{shape}}
practice.recap: You have 60 seconds. Each mistake costs 20 points: be quick, but don't guess. On a keyboard: ← and →.

quick-math.title: Quick Math
quick-math.description: Solve operations against the clock; it gets harder as you get them right.

practice.round1: Type the answer and tap OK
practice.round3: If one is too hard, you can tap Skip
practice.recap: You have 60 seconds. Each right answer scores, each mistake costs 10, and skipping costs nothing. On a keyboard: type and press Enter.

trivia-mix.title: General knowledge mix
trivia-mix.description: Questions from all 8 categories in every round.

trivia-science.title: Science
trivia-science.description: Physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy and the human body.

trivia-geography.title: Geography
trivia-geography.description: Countries, capitals, rivers, mountains and regions.

trivia-math.title: Math
trivia-math.description: Concepts, geometry, simple arithmetic and the history of math.

trivia-arts.title: Arts & literature
trivia-arts.description: Painting, authors and works, classical music and mythology.

trivia-sports.title: Sports
trivia-sports.description: World Cups, the Olympics and the rules of each sport.

trivia-technology.title: Technology
trivia-technology.description: Inventions, computing and the history of the internet.

accounting-concepts.title: Accounting concepts
accounting-concepts.description: Double entry, financial statements, accruals and reconciliations.

accounting-colombia.title: Accounting in Colombia
accounting-colombia.description: PUC, IFRS, VAT, withholding tax, ICA and e-invoicing.

accounting-us.title: US accounting
accounting-us.description: US GAAP, ASC topics, IRS forms and QuickBooks.

accounting-lending.title: Lending & loan portfolio
accounting-lending.description: Interest, amortization, payoff, aging, allowances and charge-offs.

switchyard.title: Switchyard
switchyard.description: Flip the track switches so every train reaches the station of its color.

practice.tap: Tap the switch (the circle with an arrow) so the red train goes to the red station, the circle one
practice.moving: Now the train moves on its own: switch the track before it reaches the switch
practice.two: Several can come at once: take each one to its station
practice.hintYellow: The yellow train goes to the yellow station, the square one. Try again
practice.hintEach: Each train goes to the station of its color and shape. Try again
practice.recap: You have 90 seconds. Each train that reaches its station scores; if it reaches another, it scores nothing. They speed up while you get them right. On a keyboard: numbers 1 to 9.

star-shower.title: Star Shower
star-shower.description: Solve the sums on the falling stars before they reach the horizon.
instructions: Stars with sums are falling. Type the answer on the on-screen keypad or your keyboard and press OK (or Enter) to pop them.
The golden comet pops every star on the screen. A wrong number costs no points: just try again.
If a star reaches the horizon, you lose a life and the other stars vanish. Lose 3 and the game ends.

play.practiceNote: For practice: your suggested level ({{n}}) stays as it is.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.intro: 10-question rounds of general knowledge and accounting.

example.question: Which is the largest planet in the Solar System?
example.explanation: Jupiter has more than twice the mass of all the other planets combined.

instructions: Answer 10 questions; you have 20 seconds for each.
Tap the right answer or use keys 1 to 4. Then you'll see the answer and a short explanation.
Each correct answer earns 20 points, plus up to 10 for speed. Each mistake costs 10 points (30 on true-or-false questions).
If you don't know, tap “I don't know” or key 0: you'll see the answer without losing points.
